title: FAIRNESS EVALUATION OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN ACADEMIC LIBRARY REFERENCE SERVICES

bias_targets.methodology: Synthesizing library reference queries using first names that implicitly signal male or female sex, and using diagnostic machine learning classifiers on the LLM responses to detect systematic linguistic differences.

Synthesizing library reference queries using surnames probabilistically associated with six different racial and ethnic categories, and training classifiers on TF-IDF features of the LLM responses to check for group-based variations.

Appending explicit patron roles (e.g., undergraduate, faculty, staff, alumni) to synthesized email queries and using predictive classifiers alongside linguistic feature analysis to evaluate role-based accommodation and variation in formality or politeness.
